bibliography.title: MemoryBench: A Benchmark for Memory and Continual Learning in LLM Systems

abstract_sentences.text: Scaling up data, parameters, and test-time computation has been the mainstream methods to improve LLM systems (LLMsys), but their upper bounds are almost reached due to the gradual depletion of high-quality data and marginal gains obtained from larger computational resource consumption.

Inspired by the abilities of human and traditional AI systems in learning from practice, constructing memory and continual learning frameworks for LLMsys has become an important and popular research direction in recent literature.

Yet, existing benchmarks for LLM memory often focus on evaluating the system on homogeneous reading comprehension tasks with long-form inputs rather than testing their abilities to learn from accumulated user feedback in service time.

Therefore, we propose a user feedback simulation framework and a comprehensive benchmark covering multiple domains, languages, and types of tasks to evaluate the continual learning abilities of LLMsys.

Experiments show that the effectiveness and efficiency of state-of-the-art baselines are far from satisfying, and we hope this benchmark could pave the way for future studies on LLM memory and optimization algorithms.

experimental_design.name: research_questions
experimental_design.description: §3.3 明列 simulation usefulness、systems' continual-learning performance、limitations/future directions 三个问题。

experimental_design.name: datasets_and_scope
experimental_design.description: 11 public datasets，3 domains、4 task formats、2 languages；Table 3 提供 case、metric 和 text length。

experimental_design.name: partitions_and_sampling
experimental_design.description: 按 domain 与 task format 建 7 类 partition，均匀抽样并以 4:1 分 train/test；每类别最多 250 samples。

experimental_design.name: leakage_control
experimental_design.description: feedback logs 只在 training set 生成，test data 不输入 simulator。

experimental_design.name: feedback_simulator
experimental_design.description: main settings 以 Qwen3-32B 作 LLM-as-user，另提供 Mistral3.2-24B；objective tasks 可走 metric mapping。

experimental_design.name: policy_settings
experimental_design.description: off-policy 预生成每 training case 一段 feedback session；on-policy 每 step 收集 batch 后更新。

experimental_design.name: metrics_and_aggregation
experimental_design.description: 遵循 dataset metric，多 metric 合并为 1–10；dataset 内 min-max 或 z-score 后跨 dataset 平均。

experimental_design.name: hardware
experimental_design.description: A800-80G cluster；Qwen3-8B 经 vLLM 8-way GPU parallelism。

experimental_design.description: 文章只称 sampling 使用 fixed random seed，未报 seed 数值。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 本文把历史 user feedback log 变成 procedural memory 的评测资源，以 future held-out task performance 诊断 continual learning。〔PDF pp. 2–6，§1–§3.2，interpretation〕
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 主文保留 taxonomy、三模块 architecture、11-dataset 范围、baseline comparison、aggregate result 和 time figure。〔PDF pp. 3–8，Table 1、Figures 1–4，layout_observation〕
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix 移入 judge prompts、dataset/parameter details、human annotation、raw results、policy/noise/backbone analyses 和 case study。〔PDF pp. 13–43，A.1–A.3，layout_observation〕
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 的 training/test flow 紧接 §3 的 baseline evaluation，使 feedback log 到 held-out score 的证据路径可扫读。〔PDF pp. 5–7，Figure 2、§3，layout_observation〕
final_judgment.largest_gap: feedback quality 的 validation 是 simulated-vs-human proxy 加短程 with/without comparison；真实 deployment learning outcome 未被检验。〔PDF pp. 23–25、33；p. 9，A.2.5／A.3.5／§5，interpretation〕
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 若主张系统从历史交互学习，应明确写出 feedback 的数据形态、memory update 位置、held-out future-task estimand 与 failure/cost condition。〔PDF pp. 2–8，§1–§3.3，interpretation〕
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 此规则适合可模拟或可获得历史交互的任务；真实 user log、privacy、bias 与长期 deployment 效果仍需额外设计。〔PDF p. 9，§5／Impact Statement，explicit〕
final_judgment.lexical_rhetoric: 主文粗粒度 direct-PDF prose 计数显示 memory 约97、LLMsys约96、MemoryBench约42、user feedback约31、continual learning约27；`propose`、`evaluate`、`test` 支持方案/评测叙事，`Yet`、`However`、`In contrast` 组织缺口。计数未完全剥离图表，作为语境提示。〔PDF pp. 1–9，Abstract–§5，layout_observation〕
